verdict.rationale: Notion's own docs say it can search content in Notion and connected sources (via Notion MCP) and promise instant answers with citations, so workspace search is a documented first-party capability. The evidence is thin, though: nothing explicitly confirms that comments are indexed, and nothing backs speed or accuracy. One older community comment says search 'still needs some love', which lowers confidence but is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of comments and database tasks in search, documented search performance and relevance, and independent hands-on corroboration of fast, accurate results.
